messages.subject: [IT] Document management system maintenance — Saturday 14 March
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The DMS will be unavailable from 20:00 Saturday 14 March to 02:00 Sunday 15 March for scheduled maintenance and a security patch. Please check in any documents before 19:45. Email and the time-recording system are unaffected.

Thanks,
IT Helpdesk
